lemma erdos_968.variants.infinite_increasingTriples_aux :
    ∃ n : ℕ, u n < u (n + 1) ∧ u (n + 1) < u (n + 2) := by
  have h : u 0 = 1 := by
    unfold u
    norm_num
  have h' : u 1 = 2 := by
    unfold u
    norm_num
  have h'' : u 2 = 3 := by
    unfold u
    norm_num
  rw [h, h', h'']
  norm_num
  <;>
  (try norm_num)
  <;>
  (try all_goals
    (try norm_num)
    <;>
    (try exact le_of_lt (show (1:ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)))
